description: This file defines the AuthRepository class which provides methods for user authentication, including login and registration, by interacting with an ApiService.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling user authentication API calls.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with email and password, returning a UserSession.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password, returning a UserSession.
